name: medium
description: Medium is a multi-tenant SaaS scaffold that lets solo physical therapists manage patient bookings over WhatsApp with an AI assistant, overseen from a mobile-first PWA. It is built on Next.js App Router with Tailwind CSS and shadcn/ui, with placeholder API routes for WhatsApp, Meta embedded auth, and Inngest still to be wired to live services. Note: this project has over 100 source files; consider scoping analysis to a subdirectory for faster results.
